claims.evidence: Photos show a metal alternator/charging unit but no readable label/serial/brand or origin markings.
No output/voltage test, no multimeter reading, and no running/bench test clip shown.
Photos cannot confirm internal noise; no audio/video of operation is shown.
No mileage/usage indicator or readable part label is shown.
Photos do not show tamper evidence or internal inspection; no seal/cover condition is clearly verifiable.

claims.claim: Also deals on all kinds of cars spare parts.
claims.evidence: This is a general business statement not evidenced by the alternator photos.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: alternator rating (amps/voltage), pulley type/size, and mounting fit may not match the buyer’s vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the alternator nameplate/label (brand, part number, voltage, amperage) plus a photo of the pulley/shaft end and mounting bracket holes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used car alternator with unknown fit/ratings (worst-case compatibility).

risks.risk: Functional risk: internal diode/regulator/bearing/brush condition may be faulty even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: A bench test or in-vehicle test showing voltage output under load (e.g., multimeter readings at idle and with accessories on) and a short video of it running.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: may need repair or replacement).

risks.risk: Hidden damage/corrosion: corrosion on terminals, cracked housing, or worn bearings may not be visible from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the electrical terminals/connector area, the threaded shaft/stud, and any seams for cracks/corrosion (high-resolution, well-lit).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with unknown wear (worst-case: possible corrosion/defects).

risks.risk: Missing accessories: pulley, fan, wiring plug/connector, mounting bolts, or regulator components may be missing or not included.
risks.proof: A full set photo showing what is included laid out (pulley/fan, connector/wiring plug, mounting hardware, belt/drive parts if any).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the alternator nameplate/label showing brand, part number, voltage, and amperage (or any readable markings).
Send a short video of the alternator being tested (bench test or in-vehicle) with multimeter/charger readings visible.
Send close-up photos of the electrical terminals/connector area and the threaded shaft/stud for corrosion or damage.
Confirm and photograph exactly what accessories are included (pulley/fan, wiring plug/connector, mounting bolts/hardware, belt/drive parts if any).
response.reason: The witness report consistently identifies the item type as a car alternator/charging unit, so it can be priced at a worst-case used level. Seller claims about testing, mileage, and origin are not verifiable from the provided images, so the price should reflect unknown working condition and compatibility.
